uncertainty: IPC covers 118 districts in 12 Government-controlled governorates, uses information available through 20 April 2026, has medium evidence, and is not a whole-of-Yemen current observation. WFP reported deteriorating food access and renewed displacement on 2 October, so the IPC projection predates material changes and is not an updated current estimate; WFP's national figures and monitoring denominators are not comparable substitutes for the IPC classification. The Sana'a Center evidence is purposive fieldwork in six rural study areas and is not nationally representative. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
